entries.0ee2ffb4fb0c3dbe: A machinery manufacturer that manufactures and sells agricultural and forestry machinery such as sprayers and brush cutters, industrial high-pressure pumps, fire extinguishers, and more.
entries.28213354ec3174d1: This business manufactures and sells industrial high-pressure pumps, high-pressure washers, ultra-fine bubble products, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 is ¥6,581 million. Industrial machinery is mainly manufactured by the company, and some is manufactured by Seibu Maruyama Co., Ltd. The company sells through domestic authorized dealers and overseas general agents, and the consolidated subsidiary ASIAN MARUYAMA(THAILAND)CO.,LTD. also sells the industrial machinery supplied by the company through authorized dealers.
entries.2f4aa93f99e1a979: Users in Japan through authorized dealers
entries.70edbe35a2cdee8b: Agricultural and forestry operators in Japan and overseas, through authorized dealers
entries.7ae5deae2af5ab40: This business manufactures and sells power sprayers, power dusters, large-scale pest control machines, brush cutters, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 is ¥32,020 million, the largest of the four reportable segments. Pest control machines are mainly manufactured by the company, and some are manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries Nihon Kuraisu Co., Ltd., Seibu Maruyama Co., Ltd. and MARUYAMA MFG(THAILAND)CO.,LTD. Forestry machinery (brush cutters) is mainly manufactured by Nihon Kuraisu Co., Ltd. and MARUYAMA MFG(THAILAND)CO.,LTD. The company sells domestically and overseas through the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations, Kubota Corporation and authorized dealers, and in overseas markets consolidated subsidiaries also handle sales.
entries.ab4b14bd2b6c4da1: This business engages in real estate leasing and electricity sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 is ¥192 million. The company conducts both.
entries.d0bdb228a3584b88: Business partners such as the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations and Kubota Corporation
entries.d5a0fba8f0c7e625: This business manufactures and sells fire extinguishers, disaster prevention equipment, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 is ¥2,472 million. Fire-fighting machinery is manufactured by the consolidated subsidiary Maruyama Ekuseru Co., Ltd. and sold through authorized dealers.
